My stay at the hotel was truly wonderful. The people here are warm and welcoming, and always just seconds away whenever you need anything. The staff is well-behaved, well-mannered, and incredibly attentive. Thank you for the comfortable stay. A special thanks to Sachin and Amit for their understanding and exceptional service.

And their dal kichidi is next level…tq

Good homestay if you are staying at Noida. Rooms are very clean with facilities like smart TV, AC, Heater, Bath tub, Kitchen, Refrigerator, Oven, etc.. Room service and staff is very well mannered,polite and helpful. Food has scope for improvement.
It was a pleasant stay. Rooms are nice. The whole staff is corporative. Sachin and Amit was amazing. Great service.
